content: Ximtoossi Phawuloosaranne Sillasera issife gidides
Phawuloosi Derbeene geetettizasone Listira gakkidi iza aaway Girike as, aayiya qas Ayhuda as gidida Ximtoosa geetettiza issi ammanizade heen demmides.
Izikka Listiraninne Iqoniyoon ammaniza asa achchan lo7o markateth dizadde.
Phawuloosikka Ximtoosa banara ekki baanas koyides. Hessa gish he heeran Ayhudata gish giidi Ximtoosa qaxxarides. Gaasoyka Ayhudati Ximtoosa aaway Girike as gididayssa eriza gishassa.
Isti issi katamappe hara katama aadhdhi aadhdhi bishe Hawaaretinne Yerusalame Woosa Keeththa cimati yeddida kiita asay ekkidi naagana mala ammaniza asas immi immi aadhdhida.
Woosa keeththa asay ammanon minni minni bides; qasse asaykka qoodan gallas gallas gujetti gujetti bides.
Phawuloosi Maqidooniya gish beyida ajjuta
Phawuloosinne izara diza zatati qaala Iisiyan sabakonta mala Xillo Ayanay diggida gish Pirgiyaranne Galatiya derera aadhdhi bida.
Isti Miisiya geetettizaso gakkana matishe Bitiniya geetettizaso gelana qoppin Yesusa Ayanay ista diggides.
Hessa gish Miisiyara aadhdhidi Xiro7aada geetettizaso wodhdhida.
Issi Maqidooniya asi eqqidi Phawuloosa ha Maqidooniya pinnada nuna maadda gishin Phawuloosi omars ajjutan beyides.
Izikka he ajjuta beyidi Xoossi nu istas Mishiraachcho qaala yootana mala xeygides gi qachidi nu heerakka gede Maqidooniya baana koyidos.
Piliphoosen Liidiyay Goda ammanadus
Markabera Xiro7aada geetettizasoppe dendidi siti giidi Samotiraaqe geetettizaso bidos. Wontetha gallas Naaphule gizaso sinth hamuth gujjidos.
Heeppeka Oroome asay tooran haarida dere gidida Maqidooniya dere waanna katama gidida Piliphisiyoose geetettizaso gelidos. Heenka undena wode uttidos.
Sambata gallas woossa woossizaso koyishe katama gelizaso penge kezidi duge shaafa wodhdhos; nu heen uttidi shiiqi diza macasas qaala yootidos.

Qaala lo7ethi siyiza macasatappe issi Lidiya geetettizara izakka Xoosse goynzaronne Tiyaxiroone katamappe yaada zo7o Hare may7o zal7izaro Phawuloosi yootiza qaala iza woznan wotha siyana mala Goday izi wozna doyides.
Izanne iziso asaykka xammaqettidappe guye iza ista ta Xoosse ammanidi inte tumu erida gidikko ha taso yiidi guutha wode diishshite gaada ista mintha woossadus.
Phawuloosinne Sillassi qasho keeththan
Issi gallas nu woossaso bishin kayo kayotta marotza issi garade naa dizaara nuna demmadus. Izakka ba maroteththan bana ayssizaytas daro miish gelthawus.
Hanna garade naya Phawuloosanne nuna kaalla kaalla “Hayti asati intes inte attana oge yootizayti wogga Xoossa oosanchata” ga ga waassadus.

Hessaka daro gallas shira shira gadus. Gido attin Phawuloosi ha Izi qaalan daro metotida gish izikko simmidi izi duunara haasayiza tuna ayanaza “Ne izippe kezana mala ta nena Goda Yesus Kirstoosa sunthan azazays” gides. He ayanay heerakka yeggi izippe kezides.
Izo ayssiza asati istas miishe demmiza ogey duuxxin ista ufayssi qanxettidayssi istas gelin Phawuloosanne Silase oykkidi biittara goochchidi waannati dizaso giya giddo efida.
Dere ayssiza waannatakko shiishshidi “Hayti asati baas Ayhuda as gidi uttidi nu katama bulakketes;
qasse nu Oroome asati ekkanas woykko ooththanas nuus bessonta woga nu asa giddon laalettes” gida.
Dereyka issi bolla gididi Phawuloosa bollanne Sillase bolla dendides. Deraa ayssizayti Phawuloosanta may7o qaari ekkidi durqara qoxana mala azazida.
Iita buka bukkidi gede qasho keeththan yeggida. Qasho keeththa naagizayssika ista lo7ethi naagana mala azazida.
Izikka hessa mala mino azazo ekkidi qasho keeththas waanna giddo kifile gelthidi ista toho gita durumara shiishshi qachides.
Giddi gidoth gidishin Phawuloosinne Sillassi woossaninne mazamuren Xoossa galatishin qasho asay ista yethanne galata ezgi siyides.
Hassa7ay baynda dingate qasho keeththa xaphoppe qaathiza mino biitta qaathi hanides; heerakka qasho keeththa pengeti doyettida. Qashetida ubba asa qashoy birshettides.
Qasho keeththa naagizayssi dhiskofe beeggidi qasho keeththa pengeti doya dizayssa beyidi qasho asay wuri kessi ekkida misatin bana wodhana mashsha shoddides.
Phawuloosi qas ba qaala dhoqu histidi “Nu wuri haan doos! Ne bolla ayne iita ooththofa” gi waassides.
Qasho keeththa nagizayssi xompe woossi ekkidi gede giddo guppi gelides; kokkorshe Phawuloosa toho bollanne Sillase toho bolla kundides.
Ista ekki kare kezidi “Ha asato! Ta attana mala ay ooththoo?” gides.
Istika izas “Goda Yesusa ammana; nekka neso asaykka inte wuri attana” gida.
Hessafe guye izassinne izason diza asas ubbas Goda qaala yootida.
Qasho keeththa naagizayssi heerakka he gallas qamara efidi ista maduntha meecides. Heerakka izinne izaso asay wuri xaamaqetida.
Qasho keeththa naagizayssika ista ba keeththe efidi istas kath aaththides. Baso asa ubbara Xoossa ammanida gish addezi daro ufayides.
Gadey wontishin dere ayssizayti “Heyta asata birsha yedda” giidi ba shuumeta qasho keeththa naagizayssako yeddida.
Qasho keeththa naagizayssika istas “Dere ayssizayti inte birshettana mala azazida; hessa gish ha7i saron kezi biite” giidi Phawuloosas yootides.

Phawuloosi qas “Nu Oroome yeleteth gidishin pirday baynda dere sinthan durqara bukkidinne qasho keeththan yeggida. Histin ha7i qas nuna qotara asi eronta kessana koyizoo? Hessi hanenna; isti yiidi barka birshetto!” gides.
Shuumeti he izi gida qaala dere ayssizaytas yootida istika Phawuloosinne Sillassi Oroome yeletta gididayssa siydi daggammida.
Yiidi istafe maareteth oychidi woyneppe kessida. Isti he katamayo aggidi haraso baana mala ista woossida.
Phawuloosinne Sillassi qasho keeththafe kezidi Lidiyaso bida. Henka diza ammanizayti ista daro minthethidi heeppe kezi bida.
